newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 30.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Front page report titled: "People's army loyal to the Party" emphasises party leadership of the People's Liberation Army on the eve of its 70th anniversary
- Editorial urges comprehensive effort to push forward reform of pension system.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- State Councillor Li Tieying tells conference China must accelerate its reform of social insurance
- Defence Minister Chi Haotian says China plans to build a powerful defence sector in line with the theories of late Chinese leaders Mao Zedong and Deng Xiaoping.
CHINA SECURITIES
- Foreign trade in Beijing hits $2.517 billion in first half
- Polyurethane output is expected to reach more than 700,000 tonnes by 2000
- Consumer sales of private and foreign-funded enterprises rose 43 percent and 25.9 percent respectively in first half
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- Foreign investment in Beijing hits $1.378 billion in first half
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China issues new guidelines on approving direct foreign investment in construction materials industry
MARKET DAILY
- China to build longest coal transportation pipeline in the world from Shanxi to Shandong by 2000
- China invests $4 billion in highway construction by end 1996
ECONOMIC DAILY
- Agricultural Development Bank loans rise by 39.25 billion since beginning of this year.
CHINA DAILY
- Beijing orders hospitals to stop overcharging
- Economists say China will enter period of high growth and low inflation if it maintains current macroeconomic policy
